sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a finished original modular character sprite atlas for the same cat RPG as reference1. Exactly FOUR columns by FOUR rows, sixteen separate full-body sprites inside equal square cells with generous transparent gutters. Keep the reference's hand-painted outlined storybook adventure style, chibi biped proportions, side profile facing RIGHT, NO weapons and NO forearms/hands; leave circular shoulder joint for separately drawn illustrated gun arms. New distinctive EMBER BASTION ARMOR: layered black obsidian plates, rich burnished copper shoulder rings/breastplate/greaves, bold short crimson diagonal sash and split crimson cloak tails. Warm tiny ember vents but no large fire effects. Heavy solid boots. Clearly different silhouette from existing brass/navy reference. First TWO rows: orange tabby cat green eyes. Last TWO rows: cream cat blue eyes. Same armor on both. For each cat, eight poses in reading order: 0 upright idle; 1 run left foot; 2 run middle flight; 3 run right foot; 4 run middle; 5 low forward dodging leap; 6 flinch hurt; 7 lying prone defeated with eyes closed. Keep entire tails/ears/cloak inside each cell and constant body scale. No duplicate rows, no combined characters, no text or borders. Actual transparent RGBA background, no backdrop, no checkerboard, no cast ground shadow. Production sprite sheet, full 4x4 grid.

Use case: stylized-concept. Finished original modular cat RPG character atlas matching reference1's hand-painted dark-outline adventure style and exact 4 columns by 4 rows pose layout. Sixteen separate fully contained sprites on an equal grid with ample transparent gaps. NEW GALEWEAVE MANTLE: lightweight IVORY long split coat with emerald green lapels and jade shoulder cuffs, silver fasteners, flowing narrow teal ribbon streamers instead of a heavy cloak, slim dark leather boots. Wind-swept elegant silhouette distinctly different from heavy navy armored reference. Same chibi biped cat proportions. Side profile facing right, NO weapons, NO forearms or hands; leave small circular shoulder socket for separately drawn illustrated gripping arms. Upper two rows orange tabby green eyes, lower two rows cream-white cat blue eyes. Eight poses for each cat in exact reading order: idle upright, run left foot, run middle flight, run right foot, run middle, low forward dodge leap, hurt flinch, prone defeated eyes closed. Keep costume and scale consistent. Full ears/tails/coat ribbons within each cell. Only one cat per cell. Actual transparent RGBA background. No text, labels, grid, checkerboard or background scenery. All sixteen frames, no duplicates.

Use case: stylized-concept. ORIGINAL WILD LEGENDARY KRAKEN TROPHY ARMOR modular cat RPG body sprite sheet. Reference1 supplies exact 4x4 grid,16poses and modular NO-ARM style only; replace costume completely with spectacular SEA BEAST ARMOR. Must look wild, feral, oceanic, distinctly unlike any coat or normal metal suit: deep ocean purple and turquoise overlapping organic scales; OVERSIZED ASYMMETRICAL jagged pearl-bone and barnacled shell pauldrons, one taller serrated shoulder; dramatic turquoise dorsal-fin crest behind head/shoulders without hiding face; curling thick purple tentacle tassels and tentacle mantle with luminous cyan suction-cup spots; pearl-bone ribplate, webbed scaled greaves, tiny sea-green bioluminescent accents. Recognizable clear orange/cream CAT FACE and ears unobscured. Arms are detachable: no forearms/hands, no held weapon, retain exposed circular shoulder pivot for attached gun arm. Hand-painted ink outline whimsical adventure game style with rich polished detail and readable strong silhouette. Exactly FOUR columns by FOUR rows,16 separate fully contained sprites, wide transparent gutters, no overlapping cells. Upper2rows orange tabby green eyes, lower2rows cream-white cat blue eyes. Each cat8poses in reading order: idle, run left foot, run flight, run right foot, run middle, low dodge leap, flinch hurt, lying prone defeated eyes closed. Consistent scale and costume. All fins/tentacles/tails/ears inside own cell. Actual RGBA transparency, no background, text, grid, labels, weapons or floor shadow. The silhouette should instantly read as an extravagant defeated-kraken trophy, not a tunic.

Use case: stylized-concept. Original finished isolated game equipment illustration, transparent RGBA. WINTER'S WHISPER, a precise compact frost carbine for the cat resistance RPG. Side profile aimed horizontally RIGHT. Elegant narrow silver and ivory enamel body, dark graphite trigger grip, short ivory shoulder stock, slim barrel with a small crystalline silver muzzle, distinctive long transparent CYAN ICE CHAMBER above receiver containing three small floating angular ice shards, pale icy-blue etched accents. A straight slim silver magazine. No brass, no wood, no radio aerial, no normal telescopic scope. Maintain reference1's hand-painted ink contours, practical readable gun silhouette and polished adventurous game style, but clearly distinct design and pale ice palette. Entire gun including butt and muzzle fully contained, centered on transparent canvas with generous empty margins. No hands, person, text, labels, logos, watermark, background or excessive particles. This is a gun inventory icon and faithful design reference for illustrated gripping-arm sprites.

Use case: stylized-concept. Finished illustrated firearm-gripping-arm sprite atlas for a 2D cat resistance RPG. Reference1 provides the exact established painted sleeve/two-paw grip quality. Reference2 is Winter's Whisper gun identity: preserve silver/ivory body, long cyan ice chamber with three floating ice shards, graphite grip, ivory stock, crystal muzzle, slim silver magazine. Reference3 Ember Bastion, reference4 Galeweave, reference5 Sea Beast supply matching sleeve palettes. Exactly TWO columns by SEVEN rows =14 separate sprites, portrait sheet. Every cell shows complete Winter's Whisper plus two naturally bent sleeved cat arms: trigger paw wraps pistol grip and support paw holds fore-end. Shoulder sleeve root far left, muzzle far right, weapon aimed horizontally RIGHT. No head/torso/legs. LEFT column orange-furred paws; RIGHT column cream-white paws. Both columns same outfit in each row. Row1 olive green Scout sleeves/brown fingerless gloves. Row2 dark teal Ranger sleeves/navy gloves. Row3 navy blue gold-edged Vanguard sleeves/navy gloves (also Last Watch). Row4 obsidian black and COPPER Ember Bastion armor sleeves, small crimson cuff seam. Row5 IVORY and EMERALD Galeweave sleeves, silver cuff fasteners. Row6 wild Sea Beast overlapping TURQUOISE scales and purple forearm, pearl shell cuff and cyan suction-dot trim. Row7 CHARCOAL with VIOLET crystal shoulder piece and silver cuff for Blackglass. Broad opaque round sleeve root at left for shoulder pivot. Natural three-finger cat paws, both proper grips. Same gun across all14, no alternate guns, no floating unheld gun. Fully contained sprites with large transparent gaps and generous edge margins. Polished hand-painted dark ink outline adventure style, actual transparent RGBA, no labels/text/grid/background. All seven outfit rows and two fur variants mandatory.

Use case: stylized-concept. New original PRISM SENTRY enemy sprite sheet for hand-painted cat resistance RPG. Reference1 supplies mouse proportions, polished storybook ink outlines, and EXACT 4 columns by2 rows eight-pose atlas only. New enemy is a slate-blue armored MOUSE with round ears, grey fur, small pink tail, metal visor goggles, distinctive large glowing CYAN PRISM CRYSTAL backpack with two parallel small projector nozzles aimed forward, silver circuit harness. NO mortar tube, fire, grenades or copper boiler. One entire mouse per cell, side profile faces RIGHT, clear readable stout silhouette. Eight distinct poses reading left-to-right: 0 standing idle,1 walk leftfoot,2 walk rightfoot,3 winding up double cyan prism beam with planted stance,4 firing both projectors subtle cyan flashes (no full long beams),5 venting prism with small frost mist,6 exposed reload/recovery crouch adjusting backpack,7 hurt stagger falling backward. Keep same armor/crystal details and body scale. Exactly 4columns2rows; large transparent gutters; every tail/crystal/foot completely within its cell. Actual RGBA transparency. No labels, borders, text, floor shadow or background. Finished game-ready painted sprites.

Use case: precise-object-edit. EDIT THIS SAME KRAKEN SPRITE ATLAS ONLY TO IMPROVE FRAME SEPARATION. Preserve the exact original Kraken design, colors, detailed illustrated quality, and all8poses in same order. Layout remains FOUR columns by TWO rows. SHRINK each entire creature to75percent of its current relative cell size and recenter it in its own equal rectangular cell. Leave at least35pixels fully transparent gutter on ALL FOUR SIDES of every sprite. No tentacle tip or ink cloud may touch its neighboring sprite or canvas edge. Raised slam tentacle in second frame must be fully visible with clear space above it. The eight source poses are idle,raised slam windup,slam landing,inflated ink windup,ink attack,low recovery,hurt recoil,defeated. Keep them distinct. Absolutely no new details, labels, panels or background. Actual RGBA transparent background. Complete self-contained full creatures ready for simple rectangular sprite cropping.

Use case: illustration-story. Finished original ability card illustration for a hand-painted 2D cat resistance RPG. Landscape wide 2:1 composition, rounded readable storybook ink outlines, rich cool colors. FROST BREATH: orange cat hero in dark teal resistance coat stands at left exhaling a widening cone of icy cyan breath toward two armored mice on right. Ice crystals and translucent frost coat their boots and armor, readable directional cone, no violence or injury. The effect should clearly read as short ranged freezing breath, not a gun attack. Keep main subjects in middle70percent for UI cropping. Use case: illustration-story. Finished original ability card illustration for a hand-painted 2D cat resistance RPG. Landscape wide 2:1 composition, storybook dark ink contours and rich luminous colors. initialKraken.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original finished colossal boss sprite atlas for a hand-painted cat adventure RPG. NACREMAW, THE GREAT KRAKEN: enormous ancient ocean cephalopod, eight massive curling dark-purple and deep-teal tentacles, glowing cyan suction cups and cyan predatory eyes, pale pearl-IVORY barnacled head carapace with jagged shell crown, scarred organic sea texture, turquoise fins. No cat or humanoid body. Reference1 is only the matching trophy armor's color/style language; design a real full monstrous octopus/kraken boss. Slight three-quarter front-right camera, clear complete silhouette, richly painted ink contours. Exactly FOUR columns by TWO rows = EIGHT separate full-creature animation frames, constant scale, wide transparent gutters, complete tentacles contained in every cell. Reading order: 0 idle low tentacles curled;1 SLAM WINDUP two large tentacles raised high;2 SLAM landing two tentacles flattened forward with tiny water splash;3 INK WINDUP head inflated and tentacles braced;4 INK ATTACK dark purple small ink plume at mouth, eyes cyan;5 RECOVERY drooping tentacles/head exposed;6 HURT recoiling eyes narrowed;7 DEFEATED head low eyes shut tentacles limp. Emphasize distinct readable poses while retaining identical body. No full backgrounds, no sea floor, no circular base, no labels/text/grid. Actual transparent RGBA. Wide landscape sprite sheet. Each whole boss fully inside one cell with no cropped tentacle tips. Production illustrated game artwork.
initialKraken.reason: Targeted spacing edit retained instead to separate all eight frames and preserve raised tentacle tips.
